items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bernie Glow, the trumpeter... It’s called Alex Bartha and his band, house band.

ctx.x: Yeah, they were more kind friendly there.

The other place I went to though to hear the bands was Steel Pier in Atlantic City. That’s where they had a lot of the what I call maturing bands where people like Red and so forth would mature. Bernie Glow, the trumpeter... It’s called Alex Bartha and his band, house band. They had two bandstands there. And once on the second bandstand was Duke Ellington’s famous band of the forties, and that’s where I first heard the tune Chelsea Bridge and I fell in love with that tune. I’m sitting there at night with the…
So you’re talking about Jimmy Blanton and Ben Webster and Sonny Greer and...
